common.notFoundBody: The page you were looking for does not exist.

auth.signInBody: Sign in to pick up your saved trips and bookings.
auth.signUpBody: Save itineraries, hold seats, and pick up where you left off.

packages.listBody: Curated journeys you can book as-is, reshape day by day, or hand to the AI as a starting point.
packages.emptyHint: Try widening the price range or clearing the city filter.
packages.loadError: We could not load packages just now.

packageDetail.askAi: Ask the AI about this trip
packageDetail.notFoundHint: It may have been renamed. Browse all packages instead.
packageDetail.nonBookableNote: Free time — nothing booked, nothing to pay.

customize.title: Customize your journey
customize.subtitle: Reorder days, swap where you sleep, add or drop activities. The price updates as you go.
customize.createError: We could not start a customization session.
customize.signInPrompt: Sign in to customize and save this journey.
customize.dragHint: Drag a day by its handle to reorder, or use the up and down buttons — both work with a keyboard.
customize.startDateHint: Pick a date to check availability.
customize.availabilityOk: Everything is available on these dates.
customize.availabilityProblem: {count} items are not available on these dates.
customize.askAi: Ask the AI to adjust this
customize.draftNotFound: We could not open that trip. It may have been deleted, or it belongs to another account.
customize.fromConcierge: The concierge put this together for you. Change anything you like — the price updates as you go.

home.heroTitle: Tell us the vibe. We will build the trip.
home.heroBody: Chat with a concierge that knows every temple, tuk-tuk and hidden beach in Cambodia — or browse our packages and make them your own.
home.featuredBody: Hand-built itineraries you can book as-is or reshape day by day.
home.howAiBody: Describe your dates, budget and interests. Watch a day-by-day itinerary appear as it is composed from real, bookable inventory.
home.howManualBody: Start from a package, reorder days, swap hotels and guides, and see the price update as you go.

bookings.listBody: Everything you are holding, have paid for, or have travelled on.
bookings.emptyHint: Browse packages or plan a trip with the AI to get started.
bookings.holdLapsedHint: The seats have been released. You can start again from the package.
bookings.cancelConfirm: Cancel booking {reference}? This releases your seats.
bookings.cancelError: We could not cancel that booking.
bookings.loadError: We could not load your bookings.
bookings.confirmedNote: Show your check-in code to your guide or hotel on arrival.
bookings.startBookingBody: We hold everything for 15 minutes while you pay.
bookings.createError: We could not hold that trip: {message}

checkout.title: Pay for your trip
checkout.subtitle: Your seats are held while you pay.
checkout.notConfigured: Card payments are not set up on this environment yet.
checkout.notConfiguredHint: Add Stripe test keys to enable the payment form.
checkout.payError: That payment could not be completed: {message}
checkout.secureNote: Payments are processed by Stripe. DerLg never sees your card number.
checkout.expired: This hold has expired, so there is nothing left to pay for.
checkout.alreadyPaid: This booking is already paid for.
checkout.confirmedBody: We have emailed your confirmation to {email}.
checkout.waitingHint: This usually takes a few seconds.

vibe.panelsEmpty: Options will appear here as the concierge finds them.
vibe.greetingTitle: Where would you like to go?
vibe.greetingBody: Tell me what kind of trip you want and I will find real places, hotels and guides, then put a plan together you can book.
vibe.example1: “Three days of temples in Siem Reap for two people.”
vibe.example2: “A cheap hotel near Angkor Wat under $40 a night.”
vibe.placeholder: Tell the concierge what you are looking for…
vibe.inputHint: Press Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line.
vibe.unavailable: The concierge is not available right now. You can still browse and book trips yourself.
vibe.startFailed: The concierge could not be reached. Please reload the page or browse trips instead.
